title: Why Does an Octopus Have 3 Hearts? 🐙 Fun Facts for Kids
description:
An octopus has three hearts and BLUE blood! Leo asks, big sister Mia explains how it works, in under a minute.

The CurioKids Club: short, curious answers to kids' big questions. Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@CurioKidsClub

lines.text: Mia, does an octopus really have three hearts?
It really does! Two small hearts push blood through its gills, so it can breathe underwater.
And what does the third heart do?
The big one pumps blood all around its body, all the way to its eight wiggly arms.
Is its blood red, like mine?
Blue? How is that even possible?
Our blood uses iron to carry oxygen, and that makes it red. Octopus blood uses copper instead, and copper makes it blue.
Whoa. Does all that pumping make it tired?
Here's a fun one. When an octopus swims, its big heart takes a little break! So it often likes to crawl instead.
Three hearts, blue blood and eight arms. Octopuses are amazing!
They sure are! Ask a grown-up to subscribe to The Curio Kids Club for more wonders! And next time someone asks... does an octopus really have three hearts?
